title: CRA reinvestigation of disputed information
summary: Federal law requires consumer reporting agencies to reinvestigate disputed items and record outcomes under prescribed procedures.
leverageImpact: Frames bureau-side dispute and reinvestigation expectations when tradeline accuracy is contested.
applicabilityNotes: Applies when consumer targets a CRA and dispute round is active; does not assert outcome.

title: Maximum possible accuracy standard (reporting)
summary: Consumer reports must exclude information known to be inaccurate and updated when completeness or accuracy cannot be verified.
leverageImpact: Supports accuracy-based dispute framing against CRAs.
applicabilityNotes: High-level reporting standard; pair with item-specific facts in operations.

title: Furnisher duties to correct and update information
summary: Entities furnishing information to CRAs have duties to correct and update information following disputes and when information is incomplete or inaccurate.
leverageImpact: Supports furnisher-directed dispute and correction posture when data origin is material.
applicabilityNotes: Trigger when furnisher path is structurally available or tradeline-level accuracy is in play.

title: Identity theft and blocking of information
summary: Federal law provides for blocking of adverse information resulting from identity theft when identity theft is asserted under prescribed conditions.
leverageImpact: Frames identity-theft-related blocking concepts when identity discrepancies are present in structured intake.
applicabilityNotes: Requires structured identity-context flag from claims; not a substitute for fraud affidavit workflow.

title: Debt validation in collection
summary: Federal law provides consumers a right to request validation of a debt from collectors within prescribed timelines.
leverageImpact: Frames validation leverage when collection tradelines are structurally indicated.
applicabilityNotes: Thin proxy: structured negative/collection-styled tradeline pool only; expand flags later if needed.

title: False or misleading representations (collections)
summary: Federal law prohibits false, deceptive, or misleading representations in debt collection communications.
leverageImpact: Context for collection conduct review when escalation signals are already present.
applicabilityNotes: Informational leverage slice; pair with operational response review, not automatic escalation text.

title: CFPB complaint channel (escalation)
summary: The CFPB maintains a consumer complaint mechanism that can be used as a structured escalation channel for certain market participants.
leverageImpact: Documents a structured regulatory complaint path when workflow escalation already surfaces CFPB as an action type.
applicabilityNotes: Only attaches when CFPB action is structurally present in escalation payload.
